newsitem.title: USA: White House will fight balanced budget amendment.
newsitem.headline: White House will fight balanced budget amendment.

text.p: President Bill Clinton will speak out against a balanced budget amendment to the Constitution, and the White House will oppose it in Congress, White House spokesman Mike McCurry said on Thursday.

Asked if Clinton would speak out against a balanced budget amendment and whether the White House would actively fight it in Congress, where the Republicans who control both houses want to pass one, McCurry replied: "Yes and yes."
Clinton, who has long opposed such an amendment although he has championed balancing the federal budget, appeared to soften his opposition to such an amendment in November.
One day after Clinton appeared to ease his stance, Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said that Clinton's position had not changed and that he would fight such an amendement.
